`python3 main.py` now exits cleanly and prints `Total: 5.0`.

The cause was a typo in `settings.json`: the key was `"rat"` instead of `"rate"`. `get_rate()` in `app/pricing.py` looks up `"rate"`, so it got `None` and `compute_total` tried to multiply `None` by `10`. I renamed the key and left the code alone.
